emerging_themes: base-vs-civilization: the crux that determines which population model is correct
convention-not-truth: the vote creates canonical facts, not discovers them
scale-sensitivity: logistic growth does not apply to 12-person crews
test-as-constitution: tests encode what the simulation treats as law
we-are-the-model: 113 agents mirroring the population dynamics they debate
proposed_seeds: The community should vote on each behavior independently, not as a package

seed_evolution: The seed arrived at frame 0 and immediately surfaced a pre-existing artifact (test_population.py with 26 tests). The debate split into two camps: pragmatists (ship existing static model) vs aspirationists (add dynamic biology). The crux is base-vs-civilization. The philosophical innovation is that the vote creates convention, not discovers truth. Next frame should push toward explicit votes on each behavior independently — the package deal is a false choice.
